value.action: Firmly declined the edict ordering him to marry the Princess of Yue.
Retreated into Ningjiang city when Jin forces attacked and Yidiqian died in battle.
Served as rear guard during Tianzuo's personal campaign and was defeated again.
Defended the Upper Capital against Yelu Zhangnu and forced him to withdraw.

value.description: Died of illness at age seventy.
Died in battle against Jin forces at Ningjiang Prefecture.

value.action: Rebelled and attacked the capital but withdrew without gain.
Loved learning, had a reputation for poetry, and passed the Xianyong jinshi examination.
Governed Jingzhou well by restraining clerks, checking powerful bullies, and caring for the elderly and poor.
Reviewed backlogged Upper Capital cases and reversed many wrongful convictions.
Cleaned out transport-route abuses, fixed tax quotas, and increased local salaries.
Was sent to Song to mediate peace after Li Qianshun sought help during Song's attack on Xia.
Was summoned to Yuanyang Marsh and consulted on government affairs.
Received the final imperial command jointly with Asi.

value.description: Died and received the posthumous title Exalted Father and name Zhongyi.

value.action: Entered government service during Chongxi.
Fortified the area between the Yazi and Huntong Rivers.
Investigated the crown-prince case alongside Yixin and failed to clear the innocent.

value.description: Died with the posthumous title Qinhui.

value.action: Passed the jinshi examination in Chongxi 5.
With Zhao Hui and Han Zao, distributed porridge daily during famine in Yan and Ji, saving countless people.

value.description: Died in Da'an 2; the emperor was deeply grieved and increased funeral honors.

value.action: Helped Liu Shen distribute porridge during the Yan and Ji famine.
Helped Liu Shen distribute porridge during the Yan and Ji famine.
Was appointed a sleeping-hall attendant late in Chongxi and rose through important posts for good service.
With Yelu Naye, led two thousand picked horsemen and suppressed Molusi's Northern Zhubu revolt.

value.description: Retired, received Co-Seal Director rank, and died.

value.action: Rebelled as Northern Zhubu chieftain and was suppressed by Hulu and Yelu Naye.
Led two thousand picked horsemen with Hulu to suppress Molusi's revolt.

units.zh: 蕭兀納耶律儼劉伸耶律胡呂
units.en: Xiao Wuna, Yelu Yan, Liu Shen, and Yelu Hulu
units.literal: Xiao Wuna, Yelu Yan, Liu Shen, Yelu Hulu

units.zh: 蕭兀納，一名撻不也，字特免，六院部人。
units.en: Xiao Wuna, also known as Tabuye, courtesy name Te Mian, was from the Six Yuan Division.
units.literal: Xiao Wuna, also named Tabuye, style Te Mian, a man of the Six Yuan Division.

units.zh: 其先嘗為西南面拽剌。
units.en: An ancestor of his had once held the post of zhuala on the Southwestern Route.
units.literal: His forebear had once served as zhuala of the Southwestern Route.

units.zh: 兀納魁偉簡重，善騎射。
units.en: Wuna was tall and imposing, plainspoken and dignified, and excelled at mounted archery.
units.literal: Wuna was tall and imposing, plain and grave, skilled at mounted archery.

units.zh: 清寧初，兄圖獨以事入見，帝問族人可用者，圖獨以兀納對，補祗候郎君。
units.en: Early in Qingning, his elder brother Tuduo came to court on business; when the emperor asked which relatives might serve, Tuduo named Wuna, and Wuna was appointed an attendant gentleman.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, his elder brother Tuduo entered audience on business; the emperor asked which clansmen were usable, Tuduo answered with Wuna, and he was appointed attendant gentleman.

units.zh: 遷近侍敞史，護衛太保。
units.en: He rose to inner attendant recorder and then Guardian Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: He was transferred to be inner attendant recorder, then Guardian Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 大康初，為北院宣徽使。
units.en: At the start of Dakang he was made Northern Court Commissioner of the Imperial Household.
units.literal: At the beginning of Dakang, he became Northern Court Commissioner of the Imperial Household.

units.zh: 時乙辛巳害太子，因言宋魏國王和魯斡之子淳可為儲嗣。
units.en: Yixin had already destroyed the crown prince and now argued that Chun, son of Heluwo, Prince of Wei of Song, ought to be named heir.
units.literal: At that time Yixin had already harmed the crown prince, and therefore proposed that Chun, son of Song Prince of Wei Heluwo, could serve as heir designate.

units.zh: 群臣莫敢言，唯兀納及夷離畢蕭陶隗諫曰：「舍嫡不立，是以國與人也。」
units.en: No one else among the ministers dared object; only Wuna and Yilibi Xiao Taowei spoke up: "To pass over the legitimate heir is to hand the realm to outsiders."
units.literal: None of the officials dared speak; only Wuna and Yilibi Xiao Taowei remonstrated, saying, "To set aside the legitimate heir and not establish him is to give the state to others."

units.zh: 帝猶豫不決。
units.en: The emperor wavered, unable to decide.
units.literal: The emperor hesitated and could not decide.

units.zh: 五年，帝出獵，乙辛請留皇孫，帝欲從之。
units.en: In the fifth year the emperor went hunting; Yixin asked to keep the imperial grandson at court, and the emperor was inclined to consent.
units.literal: In the fifth year, the emperor went out hunting; Yixin asked that the imperial grandson be left behind, and the emperor wished to agree.

units.zh: 兀納奏曰：「竊聞車駕出遊，將留皇孫，茍保護非人，恐有他變。
units.en: Wuna memorialized: "I understand Your Majesty is about to leave on tour while keeping the imperial grandson behind; if unsuitable men are charged with his protection, I fear disaster.
units.literal: Wuna memorialized, saying, "I have heard privately that as the imperial carriage goes out on tour, the imperial grandson is to be left behind; if protection should fall to the wrong men, I fear there may be some other turn of events.

units.zh: 果留，臣請侍左右。」
units.en: If he stays behind, I beg leave to attend him in person."
units.literal: If he is indeed left behind, your subject requests to wait at his side."

units.zh: 帝乃悟，命皇孫從行。
units.en: The emperor took his meaning and ordered the grandson to come along.
units.literal: The emperor then understood and ordered the imperial grandson to accompany the journey.

units.zh: 由此始疑乙辛。
units.en: From that point the emperor began to doubt Yixin.
units.literal: From this he first grew suspicious of Yixin.

units.zh: 頃之，同知南院樞密使事，出乙辛、淳等。
units.en: Soon afterward, serving as vice administrator of the Southern Chancellery Privy Council, he drove Yixin, Chun, and their faction from court.
units.literal: Before long, as vice administrator of the Southern Chancellery Privy Council, he banished Yixin, Chun, and the rest.

units.zh: 帝嘉其忠，封蘭陵郡王，人謂近於古社稷臣。
units.en: The emperor praised his loyalty and enfeoffed him as Prince of Lanling; contemporaries said he resembled the loyal ministers of old who saved dynasties.
units.literal: The emperor praised his loyalty, enfeoffed him Prince of Lanling Commandery, and people said he approached the ancient type of minister of state and altars.

units.zh: 授殿前都點檢。
units.en: He was appointed Chief Inspector of the Palace Guards.
units.literal: He was appointed Chief Inspector of the Palace Guards.

units.zh: 上謂王師儒、耶律固等曰：「兀納忠純，雖狄仁傑輔唐，屋質立穆宗，無以過也。
units.en: The emperor told Wang Shiru, Yelu Gu, and others: "Wuna's loyalty is unstained. Not even Di Renjie's service to Tang, or Yelu Wuzhi's elevation of Muzong, exceeds what he has done.
units.literal: The emperor said to Wang Shiru, Yelu Gu, and the others, "Wuna is loyal and pure; even Di Renjie assisting Tang, or Wuzhi establishing Muzong—none surpass him.

units.zh: 卿等宜達燕王知之。」
units.en: Tell the Prince of Yan, so that he knows how highly I esteem this."
units.literal: You gentlemen should convey this to the Prince of Yan so that he knows."

units.zh: 自是令兀納輔導燕王，益見優寵。
units.en: From then on Wuna was assigned to guide the Prince of Yan and received even greater favor.
units.literal: From then on Wuna was ordered to guide and instruct the Prince of Yan, and he received still greater favor.

units.zh: 大安初，詔尚越國公主，兀納固辭。
units.en: Early in Da'an he was commanded to marry the Princess of Yue, but Wuna steadfastly refused.
units.literal: At the beginning of Da'an, an edict ordered him to marry the Princess of Yue, and Wuna firmly declined.

units.zh: 改南院樞密使，奏請掾史宜以歲月行敘，從之。
units.en: He was made Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner and proposed that staff clerks be promoted according to seniority; the court agreed.
units.literal: He was changed to Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner; he memorialized that clerks should advance by length of service, and the request was granted.

units.zh: 壽隆元年，拜北府宰相。
units.en: In Shoulong 1 he was appointed chancellor of the Northern Court.
units.literal: In the first year of Shoulong, he was appointed chancellor of the Northern Court.

units.zh: 初，天祚在潛邸，兀納數以直言忤旨。
units.en: While Tianzuo was still heir apparent, Wuna often spoke bluntly and offended him.
units.literal: Earlier, when Tianzuo was still in the Hidden Residence, Wuna several times spoke bluntly and offended the imperial will.

units.zh: 及嗣位，出為遼興軍節度使，守太傅。
units.en: Once Tianzuo took the throne, Wuna was sent out as military commissioner of Liaoxing Army with the honorary title Grand Mentor.
units.literal: When he succeeded to the throne, Wuna was sent out as military commissioner of Liaoxing Army, with the added title Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 以佛殿小底王華誣兀納借內府犀角，詔鞫之。
units.en: A palace attendant named Wang Hua falsely accused Wuna of having borrowed rhinoceros horn from the imperial stores, and an edict ordered an inquiry.
units.literal: Because Buddhist Hall attendant Wang Hua falsely accused Wuna of borrowing rhinoceros horn from the inner treasury, an edict ordered investigation.

units.zh: 兀納奏曰：「臣在先朝，詔許日取帑錢十萬為私費，臣未嘗妄取一錢，肯借犀角乎！」
units.en: Wuna replied: "Under the previous reign I was allowed one hundred thousand strings a day from the treasury for personal expenses, yet I never took a coin I was not owed—why would I borrow rhinoceros horn?"
units.literal: Wuna memorialized, saying, "Your subject, under the former reign, was permitted by edict to take one hundred thousand from the treasury daily for private expenses, yet never took a single coin inappropriately—would I borrow rhinoceros horn!"

units.zh: 天祚愈怒，奪太傅官，降寧邊州刺史，尋改臨海軍節度使。
units.en: Tianzuo was only enraged the more: he stripped Wuna of Grand Mentor, demoted him to prefect of Ningbian, and soon afterward transferred him to military commissioner of Linhai Army.
units.literal: Tianzuo grew still angrier, stripped him of the Grand Mentor title, demoted him to prefect of Ningbian, and soon changed him to military commissioner of Linhai Army.

units.zh: 兀納上書曰：「自蕭海裏亡入女直，彼有輕朝廷心，宜益兵以備不虞。」
units.en: Wuna wrote: "Since Xiao Haili defected to the Jurchen, they have begun to hold the court in contempt. We should reinforce the frontier before trouble arrives."
units.literal: Wuna submitted a memorial, saying, "Since Xiao Haili fled into the Jurchen, they hold the court in contempt; troops should be increased to guard against the unexpected."

units.zh: 不報。
units.en: His memorial went unanswered.
units.literal: There was no response.

units.zh: 天慶元年，知黃龍府事，改東北路統軍使，復上書曰：「臣治與女直接境，觀其所為，其志非小。
units.en: In Tianqing 1 he was assigned to Huanglong Prefecture, then made commander-in-chief of the Northeast Route. He wrote again: "My jurisdiction borders the Jurchen directly, and from what I observe their ambitions are far from modest.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianqing, he governed affairs at Huanglong Prefecture; he was changed to commander-in-chief of the Northeast Route and again submitted a memorial, saying, "The territory I administer borders the Jurchen directly; judging by their conduct, their ambition is no small matter.

units.zh: 宜先其未發，舉兵圖之。」
units.en: We should strike before they rise."
units.literal: We ought, before they act, to raise troops and plan against them."

units.zh: 章數上，皆不聽。
units.en: He sent memorial after memorial; none were heeded.
units.literal: Memorial after memorial went up; none were heeded.

units.zh: 及金兵來侵，戰於寧江州，其孫移敵蹇死之，兀納退走入城。
units.en: When the Jin attacked and battle was joined at Ningjiang, his grandson Yidiqian was killed; Wuna fell back into the city.
units.literal: When Jin forces came to invade, fighting at Ningjiang Prefecture, his grandson Yidiqian died in battle, and Wuna retreated and fled into the city.

units.zh: 留官屬守禦，自以三百騎渡混同江而西，城遂陷。
units.en: Leaving his staff to hold the walls, he himself crossed the Huntong River westward with three hundred horsemen—and the city fell.
units.literal: He left subordinates to defend, himself crossed the Huntong River westward with three hundred horsemen, and the city then fell.

units.zh: 後與蕭敵裏拒金兵於長濼，以軍敗免官。
units.en: Later, with Xiao Dili, he tried to hold the Jin at Changli Marsh; when the army was routed he was stripped of office.
units.literal: Later, together with Xiao Dili he resisted Jin forces at Changli Marsh and was dismissed from office when the army was defeated.

units.zh: 五年，天祚親征，兀納殿，復敗績。
units.en: In the fifth year Tianzuo took the field in person; Wuna commanded the rear guard and was defeated again.
units.literal: In the fifth year, Tianzuo personally campaigned; Wuna served in the rear guard and again suffered defeat.

units.zh: 後數日乃與百官入見，授上京留守。
units.en: Some days later he appeared at court with the other officials and was appointed regent of the Upper Capital.
units.literal: Several days later he entered audience with the hundred officials and was appointed regent of the Upper Capital.

units.zh: 六年，耶律章奴叛，來攻京城，兀納發府庫以賚士卒，諭以逆順，完城池，以死拒戰。
units.en: In the sixth year Yelu Zhangnu rebelled and marched on the capital; Wuna opened the treasury to pay the troops, appealed to them on loyalty and treason, strengthened the walls, and fought to the death.
units.literal: In the sixth year, Yelu Zhangnu rebelled and came to attack the capital city; Wuna opened the treasury to reward the soldiers, explained right and rebellion, repaired the walls, and resisted with his life.

units.zh: 章奴無所得而去。
units.en: Zhangnu withdrew without gain.
units.literal: Zhangnu gained nothing and withdrew.

units.zh: 以功授副元帥，尋為契丹都宮使。
units.en: For this service he was made vice commander-in-chief, and soon afterward Director of the Khitan Palace Establishment.
units.literal: For his merit he was appointed vice commander-in-chief, and soon became Khitan Director of the Palace Establishment.

units.zh: 天祚以兀納先朝重臣，有定策勛，每延問以政，兀納對甚切。
units.en: Tianzuo, mindful that Wuna was a senior minister of the former reign who had helped settle the succession, often consulted him on policy; Wuna answered without reserve.
units.literal: Tianzuo, because Wuna was a great minister of the former reign with merit in settling the succession, repeatedly summoned him to discuss government, and Wuna answered very forthrightly.

units.zh: 上雖優容，終不能用。
units.en: The emperor listened politely but never acted on what he said.
units.literal: Although the emperor treated him indulgently, in the end his counsel was never adopted.

units.zh: 以疾卒，年七十。
units.en: He died of illness at seventy.
units.literal: He died of illness at age seventy.

units.zh: 耶律儼，字若思，析津人。
units.en: Yelu Yan, courtesy name Ruosi, was a native of Xijin.
units.literal: Yelu Yan, style Ruosi, a man of Xijin.

units.zh: 本姓李氏。
units.en: He was descended from the Li clan.
units.literal: His original surname was Li.

units.zh: 父仲禧，重熙中始仕。
units.en: His father Zhongxi entered government service during Chongxi.
units.literal: His father Zhongxi first entered office in Chongxi.

units.zh: 清寧初，同知南院宣徽使事。
units.en: Early in Qingning he became vice commissioner of the Southern Court Imperial Household.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, he served as vice commissioner of Southern Court Imperial Household affairs.

units.zh: 四年，城鴨子、混同二水間，拜北院宣徽使。
units.en: In year four he fortified the junction of the Yazi and Huntong Rivers and was promoted to Northern Court Commissioner of the Imperial Household.
units.literal: In the fourth year he walled the area between the Yazi and Huntong rivers and was appointed Northern Court Commissioner of the Imperial Household.

units.zh: 咸雍初，坐誤奏事，出為榆州刺史。
units.en: Early in Xianyong he was demoted to prefect of Yuzhou for a faulty memorial.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong, for mistakenly memorializing a matter he was sent out as prefect of Yuzhou.

units.zh: 俄詔復舊職，遷漢人行宮都部署。
units.en: He was soon recalled to his former post and made Overall Deployment commissioner of the Han mobile palace.
units.literal: Before long an edict restored his former post, and he was transferred to be Overall Deployment commissioner of the Han Mobile Court.

units.zh: 六年，賜國姓，封韓國公，改南院樞密使。
units.en: In year six he received the imperial surname Yelu, was enfeoffed Duke of Han, and made Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was granted the imperial surname, enfeoffed Duke of Han, and changed to Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner.

units.zh: 時樞臣乙辛等誣陷皇太子，詔仲禧偕乙辛鞫之，蔓引無辜，未嘗雪正。
units.en: When Yixin and his faction framed the crown prince, Zhongxi was ordered to investigate alongside Yixin; the inquiry spread falsely to the innocent and never cleared the prince's name.
units.literal: At that time Privy Councilor Yixin and others falsely implicated the crown prince; an edict ordered Zhongxi together with Yixin to investigate, implicating the innocent in widening chains, and never clearing what was right.

units.zh: 乙辛薦仲禧可任，拜廣德軍節度使，復為南院樞密使，卒，謚欽惠。
units.en: Yixin praised Zhongxi's reliability; he was made military commissioner of Guangde Army and again Southern Privy Commissioner, and died with the posthumous title Qinhui.
units.literal: Yixin recommended Zhongxi as capable; he was appointed military commissioner of Guangde Army, again Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner, died, and was posthumously titled Qinhui.

units.zh: 儼儀觀秀整，好學，有詩名，登咸雍進士第。
units.en: Yan was handsome and well composed, devoted to learning, and celebrated as a poet; he passed the jinshi examination in Xianyong.
units.literal: Yan's bearing and appearance were elegant and fine; he loved learning, had a reputation in poetry, and passed the Xianyong jinshi examination.

units.zh: 守著作佐郎，補中書省令史，以勤敏稱。
units.en: He served as an assistant in the Bureau of Attendants and then as a secretariat clerk, praised for diligence and quickness.
units.literal: He served as Assistant Director of the Bureau of Attendants, was appointed secretariat clerk of the Central Secretariat, and was known for diligence and alertness.

units.zh: 大康初，歷都部署判官、將作少監。
units.en: Early in Dakang he served as Overall Deployment judge and then as Vice Director of Palace Construction.
units.literal: At the beginning of Dakang he successively held posts as Overall Deployment judge and Vice Director of Palace Construction.

units.zh: 後兩府奏事，論群臣優劣，唯稱儼才俊。
units.en: Later, when the two chancelleries reviewed the ministers, only Yan was singled out as exceptionally able.
units.literal: Later, when the two chancelleries reported on affairs, discussing the merits and flaws of the hundred officials, only Yan was called talented and outstanding.

units.zh: 改少府少監，知大理正，賜紫。
units.en: He was made Vice Director of the Palace Workshop and acting director of the Court of Justice, and awarded the purple official robe.
units.literal: He was changed to Vice Director of the Palace Workshop, made Director of the Court of Justice, and granted purple robe.

units.zh: 六年，遷大理少卿，奏讞詳平。
units.en: In year six he rose to Vice Director of the Court of Justice; his judgments were thorough and fair.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Justice; his memorials on cases were detailed and even.

units.zh: 明年，升大理卿。
units.en: The following year he was promoted to Director of the Court of Justice.
units.literal: The next year he was advanced to Director of the Court of Justice.

units.zh: 丁父憂，奪服，同簽部署司事。
units.en: When his father died he was recalled from mourning to serve jointly in the Deployment Office.
units.literal: Upon mourning for his father, mourning garments were stripped from him, and he served jointly signing Deployment Office affairs.

units.zh: 大安初，為景州刺史。
units.en: Early in Da'an he was appointed prefect of Jingzhou.
units.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he became prefect of Jingzhou.

units.zh: 繩胥徒，禁豪猾，撫老恤貧，未數月，善政流播，郡人刻石頌德。
units.en: He disciplined petty officials, checked the powerful, and cared for the old and poor; within months his good rule was famed throughout the prefecture, and the people carved a stone in his honor.
units.literal: He restrained clerks and runners, forbade powerful bullies, comforted the aged and pitied the poor; within a few months good government spread abroad, and the commandery people carved stone to praise his virtue.

units.zh: 二年，改御史中丞，詔按上京滯獄，多所平反。
units.en: In year two he became Censor-in-Chief and was ordered to review backlogged cases at the Upper Capital, reversing many wrongful convictions.
units.literal: In the second year he was changed to Censor-in-Chief; by edict he reviewed stagnant cases at the Upper Capital, and many wrongful verdicts were overturned.

units.zh: 同知宣徽院事，提點大理寺。
units.en: He served as vice administrator of the Imperial Household Office and supervising director of the Court of Justice.
units.literal: He was vice administrator of the Imperial Household Office and supervising director of the Court of Justice.

units.zh: 六年冬，改山西路都轉運使。
units.en: In the winter of year six he became Overall Transport Commissioner of the Western Shanxi Route.
units.literal: In the sixth year, winter, he was changed to Overall Transport Commissioner of the Western Shanxi Route.

units.zh: 刮剔垢弊，奏定課額，益州縣俸給，事皆施行。
units.en: He cleaned out abuses, fixed tax quotas, and raised county and prefecture salaries; his reforms were all enacted.
units.literal: He scraped away grime and abuses, memorialized to fix tax quotas, increased prefecture and county salaries, and all matters were put into effect.

units.zh: 壽隆初，授樞密直學士。
units.en: At the start of Shoulong he was made Privy Council Academician.
units.literal: At the beginning of Shoulong he was granted Privy Council Academician.

units.zh: 以母憂去官，尋召復舊職。
units.en: He left office to mourn his mother but was soon recalled.
units.literal: Because of mourning for his mother he left office; before long he was summoned and restored to his former post.

units.zh: 宋攻夏，李乾順遣使求和解，帝命儼如宋平之，拜參知政事。
units.en: When Song attacked Western Xia, Li Qianshun of Xia sent envoys seeking peace; the emperor dispatched Yan to mediate with Song, and on his return Yan was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: Song attacked Xia; Li Qianshun sent envoys seeking reconciliation; the emperor ordered Yan to go to Song to settle it, and he was appointed Associate Administrator of Affairs.

units.zh: 六年，駕幸鴛鴦濼，召至內殿，訪以政事。
units.en: In year six the emperor visited Yuanyang Marsh, summoned Yan to the inner hall, and questioned him on policy.
units.literal: In the sixth year, as the carriage visited Yuanyang Marsh, he was summoned to the inner hall and consulted on government affairs.

units.zh: 帝晚年倦勤，用人不能自擇，令各擲骰子，以采勝者官之。
units.en: In his later years the emperor grew weary of governing and could not choose officials himself; he had each candidate throw dice, and whoever drew the winning lot received appointment.
units.literal: In his later years the emperor grew weary of diligence; unable to choose men himself, he had each throw dice, and whoever drew the winning lot was given office.

units.zh: 儼嘗得勝采，上曰：「上相之征也！」
units.en: Yan once drew the winning lot; the emperor said, "This is the mark of a chief minister!"
units.literal: Yan once drew the winning lot; the emperor said, "This is a sign of a chief minister!"

units.zh: 遷知樞密院事，賜經邦佐運功臣，封越國公。
units.en: He was made administrator of the Privy Council Office, granted the title Merit Minister Who Supports the State in Governing, and enfeoffed Duke of Yue.
units.literal: He was transferred to administer the Privy Council Office, granted the title Merit Minister Who Supports the State in Governing, and enfeoffed Duke of Yue.

units.zh: 修《皇朝實錄》七十卷。
units.en: He compiled the Veritable Records of the Imperial Dynasty in seventy juan.
units.literal: He compiled the Veritable Records of the Imperial Dynasty in seventy juan.

units.zh: 帝大漸，儼與北院樞密使阿思同受顧命。
units.en: When the emperor fell gravely ill, Yan and Northern Chancellery Privy Commissioner Asi jointly received the final imperial command.
units.literal: When the emperor fell gravely ill, Yan together with Northern Chancellery Privy Commissioner Asi jointly received the final imperial command.

units.zh: 乾統三年，徙封秦國。
units.en: In Qiantong 3 his fief was changed to the State of Qin.
units.literal: In Qiantong 3 his fief was changed to the State of Qin.

units.zh: 六年，封漆水郡王。
units.en: In year six he was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.

units.zh: 天慶中，以疾，命乘小車入朝。
units.en: During Tianqing, because of illness, he was ordered to attend court in a small carriage.
units.literal: During Tianqing, because of illness, he was ordered to enter court riding in a small carriage.

units.zh: 疾甚，遣太醫視之。
units.en: When his illness grew severe, the court sent the chief physician to treat him.
units.literal: When his illness grew severe, the court dispatched the chief physician to attend him.

units.zh: 薨，贈尚父，謚曰忠懿。
units.en: He died; posthumously he was given the title Exalted Father, with the posthumous name Zhongyi ("Loyal and Magnanimous").
units.literal: He died; posthumously he was given the title Exalted Father, with the posthumous name Zhongyi.

units.zh: 儼素廉潔，一芥不取於人。
units.en: Yan was incorruptible by nature and would accept nothing, not even the smallest gift, from anyone.
units.literal: Yan by nature was incorrupt and pure; he would not take even a mustard seed from others.

units.zh: 經籍一覽成誦。
units.en: He could read a classical text once and recite it from memory.
units.literal: Classical texts, one glance and he could recite them.

units.zh: 又善伺人主意。
units.en: He was also skilled at reading the emperor's mind.
units.literal: He was also skilled at reading others' intentions.

units.zh: 妻邢氏有美色，常出入禁中，儼教之曰：「慎勿失上意。」
units.en: His wife, née Xing, was beautiful and frequently entered the inner palace; Yan told her: "Take care never to displease the emperor."
units.literal: His wife Lady Xing had beautiful looks and often entered and left the forbidden precincts; Yan instructed her, saying, "Be careful never to lose the emperor's favor."

units.zh: 由是權寵益固。
units.en: By this means their influence at court grew ever stronger.
units.literal: By this his power and favor grew firmer still.

units.zh: 三子：處貞，太常少卿；
units.en: He had three sons: Chuzhen, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices;
units.literal: Three sons: Chuzhen, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices;

units.zh: 處廉，同知中京留守事；
units.en: Chulian, vice regent of the Central Capital;
units.literal: Chulian, vice regent of the Central Capital;

units.zh: 處能，少府少監。
units.en: and Chuneng, Vice Director of the Palace Workshop.
units.literal: Chuneng, Vice Director of the Palace Workshop.

units.zh: 劉伸，字濟時，宛平人。
units.en: Liu Shen, courtesy name Jishi, was from Wanping.
units.literal: Liu Shen, style Jishi, a man of Wanping.

units.zh: 少穎悟，長以辭翰聞。
units.en: Quick-witted as a youth, he later won renown for his writing.
units.literal: In youth he was quick and perceptive; grown, he was known for literary composition.

units.zh: 重熙五年，登進士第，歷彰武軍節度使掌書記、大理正。
units.en: In Chongxi 5 he passed the jinshi examination and served as recorder to the Zhangwu Army military commissioner and then as director of the Court of Justice.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Chongxi he passed the jinshi examination, and successively served as recorder to the military commissioner of Zhangwu Army and Director of the Court of Justice.

units.zh: 因奏獄，上適與近臣語，不顧，伸進曰：「臣聞自古帝王必重民命，願陛下省臣之奏。」
units.en: Once while presenting a case report the emperor was chatting with courtiers and ignored him; Shen stepped forward: "Since antiquity wise rulers have held the people's lives sacred; I beg Your Majesty to hear my report."
units.literal: While reporting on cases, the emperor happened to be speaking with close ministers and paid no attention; Shen stepped forward and said, "Your subject has heard that from antiquity emperors and kings must heavily regard the people's lives; I pray Your Majesty will attend to your subject's memorial."

units.zh: 上大驚異，擢樞密都承旨，權中京副留守。
units.en: The emperor was astonished, promoted him to chief usher of the Privy Council, and acting vice regent of the Central Capital.
units.literal: The emperor was greatly startled and impressed, promoted him to chief usher of the Privy Council, and acting vice regent of the Central Capital.

units.zh: 詔徙富民以實春、泰二州，伸以為不可，奏罷之。
units.en: When an edict ordered wealthy households relocated to populate Chun and Tai Prefectures, Shen objected and had the order revoked.
units.literal: An edict ordered wealthy households moved to populate Chun and Tai Prefectures; Shen held this wrong and memorialized to cancel it.

units.zh: 遷大理少卿，人以不冤。
units.en: Promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Justice, he was known for leaving no one wrongfully condemned.
units.literal: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Justice; people said no one suffered wrongly.

units.zh: 升大理卿，改西京副留守。
units.en: He rose to Director of the Court of Justice and then became vice regent of the Western Capital.
units.literal: He was advanced to Director of the Court of Justice and changed to vice regent of the Western Capital.

units.zh: 以父憂，終制，為三司副使，加諫議大夫，提點大理寺。
units.en: After completing mourning for his father, he served as Vice Commissioner of the Three Bureaus with the added title Remonstrance Grandee and as supervising director of the Court of Justice.
units.literal: Upon mourning for his father, after completing the mourning period he became Vice Commissioner of the Three Bureaus, with the added title Remonstrance Grandee, and supervising director of the Court of Justice.

units.zh: 以伸明法而恕，案冤獄全活者眾，徙南京副留守。
units.en: Known for mastery of the law and merciful judgment, he saved many from false imprisonment, and was transferred to vice regent of the Southern Capital.
units.literal: Because Shen understood law yet was forgiving, in cases of wrongful imprisonment many lives were wholly spared; he was transferred to vice regent of the Southern Capital.

units.zh: 俄改崇義軍節度使，政務簡靜，民用不擾，致烏鵲同巢之異，優詔褒之。
units.en: Soon afterward he became military commissioner of Chongyi Army; his rule was calm and unobtrusive, the people untroubled, and crows and magpies were seen nesting together—a portent of peace for which he received an imperial commendation.
units.literal: Before long he was changed to military commissioner of Chongyi Army; government affairs were simple and quiet, the people's livelihood undisturbed, producing the prodigy of crows and magpies nesting together, and an excellent edict praised him.

units.zh: 改戶部使，歲入羨余錢三十萬緡，拜南院樞密副使。
units.en: As Households Commissioner he delivered three hundred thousand strings in annual surplus and was promoted to vice privy commissioner of the Southern Chancellery.
units.literal: He was changed to Households Commissioner; annual surplus money of three hundred thousand strings was submitted, and he was appointed Southern Chancellery Vice Privy Commissioner.

units.zh: 道宗嘗謂大臣曰：「今之忠直，耶律玦、劉伸而已！」
units.en: Daozong once told his ministers: "Today only Yelu Jue and Liu Shen are truly loyal and upright!"
units.literal: Daozong once told his great ministers, "Among those loyal and upright today, only Yelu Jue and Liu Shen!"

units.zh: 宰相楊績賀其得人。
units.en: Chancellor Yang Ji praised him for recognizing worthy men.
units.literal: Chancellor Yang Ji congratulated him on getting the right men.

units.zh: 拜參知政事。
units.en: Shen was appointed Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: He was appointed Associate Administrator of Affairs.

units.zh: 上諭之曰：「卿勿憚宰相。」
units.en: The emperor told him: "Do not hold back for fear of the chancellor."
units.literal: The emperor instructed him, saying, "You, sir, need not fear the chancellor."

units.zh: 時北院樞密使乙辛勢焰方熾，伸奏曰：「臣於乙辛尚不畏，何宰相之畏！」
units.en: Yixin, Northern Privy Commissioner, was at the height of his power; Shen replied: "If I do not fear Yixin, why should I fear the chancellor?"
units.literal: At that time Northern Chancellery Privy Commissioner Yixin's power and flame were just blazing; Shen memorialized, saying, "Your subject does not even fear Yixin—why fear the chancellor!"

units.zh: 乙辛銜之，相與排詆，出為保靜軍節度使。
units.en: Yixin took offense; he and his allies smeared Shen and had him sent out as military commissioner of Baojing Army.
units.literal: Yixin harbored resentment; together they slandered and drove him out as military commissioner of Baojing Army.

units.zh: 上終欲大用，加守太子太保，遷上京留守。
units.en: The emperor still meant to use him at the highest level: Shen was given the honorary title Guardian Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and made regent of the Upper Capital.
units.literal: The emperor in the end wished to employ him greatly; he was given the added title Guardian Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and transferred to regent of the Upper Capital.

units.zh: 乙辛以事徙鎮雄武，復以崇義軍節度使致仕。
units.en: Yixin was transferred to Xiongwu on account of his offenses; Liu Shen retired once more, retaining the honorary rank of military commissioner of Chongyi Army.
units.literal: Yixin, because of a matter, was transferred to command Xiongwu; Shen again retired with the rank of military commissioner of Chongyi Army.

units.zh: 適燕、薊民饑，伸與致政趙徽、韓造日濟以糜粥，所活不勝算。
units.en: Just then famine struck Yan and Ji; Shen, together with the retired officials Zhao Hui and Han Zao, distributed porridge daily and saved countless lives.
units.literal: When Yan and Ji peoples suffered famine, Shen together with retired Zhao Hui and Han Zao daily supplied porridge; those saved cannot be counted.

units.zh: 大安二年卒，上震悼，賻贈加等。
units.en: In Da'an 2 he died; the emperor was deeply grieved and granted enhanced funeral gifts and posthumous honors.
units.literal: In the second year of Da'an he died; the emperor was shaken and grieved, and funeral gifts and posthumous rewards were increased by degrees.

units.zh: 耶律胡呂，字蘇撒，弘義宮分人。
units.en: Yelu Hulu, courtesy name Susa, was from the Hongyi Palace Division.
units.literal: Yelu Hulu, style Susa, a man of the Hongyi Palace Division.

units.zh: 其先欲穩，佐太祖有功，為叠烈部夷離堇。
units.en: His ancestor Yiwen had aided Taizu with distinction and served as yilijin of the Dielie Division.
units.literal: His forebear Yiwen assisted Taizu with merit and was yilijin of the Dielie Division.

units.zh: 父楊五，左監門衛大將軍。
units.en: His father Yang Wu was a general of the Left Gate Guards.
units.literal: His father Yang Wu, General of the Left Gate Guards.

units.zh: 胡呂性謙謹，於人無適莫。
units.en: Hulu was modest and careful by nature and showed no partiality toward anyone.
units.literal: Hulu by nature was modest and careful; toward people he had no favoring or shunning.

units.zh: 重熙末，補寢殿小底。
units.en: Late in Chongxi he was appointed a sleeping-hall attendant.
units.literal: At the end of Chongxi he was appointed sleeping-hall attendant.

units.zh: 以善職，屢更華要，遷千牛衛大將軍。
units.en: For distinguished service he rose through one prestigious post after another and was promoted to general of the Thousand-Ox Guard.
units.literal: For excellence in office he repeatedly changed to splendid and important posts, and was promoted to General of the Thousand-Ox Guard.

units.zh: 大安中，北阻卜酋磨魯斯叛，為招討都監，與耶律那也率精騎二千討平之，以功為漢人行宮副部署，兼知太和宮事。
units.en: During Da'an the Northern Zhubu chieftain Molusi rebelled; Hulu served as supervising commissioner of the pacification campaign and, with Yelu Naye, led two thousand picked horsemen to crush the revolt; for this he was made vice deployment commissioner of the Han mobile palace and concurrently administrator of Taihe Palace.
units.literal: In Da'an, the Northern Zhubu chieftain Molusi rebelled; he served as overall pacification supervising commissioner, together with Yelu Naye led two thousand picked horsemen to suppress and pacify them, and for merit became vice deployment commissioner of the Han Mobile Court, concurrently administering Taihe Palace affairs.

units.zh: 致仕，加同中書門下平章事，卒。
units.en: He retired with the added title of Co-Seal Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and later died.
units.literal: He retired, was given the added title Co-Seal Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and died.

units.zh: 論曰：兀納當道宗昏惑之會，擁佑皇孫，使乙辛奸計不獲復逞，而遼祚以續，比之屋質立穆宗，非溢美也。
units.en: The historians comment: At a moment when Daozong had lost his judgment, Wuna protected the imperial grandson and blocked Yixin's treachery from running its course, thereby preserving the Liao succession. To compare him with Yelu Wuzhi's elevation of Muzong is no flattery.
units.literal: Comment: Wuna, at the time when Daozong was confused and deluded, supported and protected the imperial grandson, causing Yixin's treacherous scheme not to obtain display again, and the Liao line thereby continued—compared to Wuzhi establishing Muzong, this is no excess of praise.

units.zh: 儼以俊才蒞政，所至有能譽，纂述遼史，具一代治亂，亦云勤矣，但其固寵，不能以禮正家，惜哉。
units.en: Yan governed with outstanding talent and won a reputation for competence wherever he served; his compilation of the History of Liao, recording an entire age of order and disorder, shows real diligence as well—yet he secured imperial favor through his wife's conduct in the inner palace rather than by keeping his household in ritual order. A pity.
units.literal: Yan, with outstanding talent administering government, wherever he arrived had reputation for ability; compiling and describing the History of Liao, fully treating one generation's order and chaos, may also be called diligent—but his securing favor, unable to correct the household by ritual, alas.

units.zh: 劉伸三為大理，民無冤抑，一登戶部，上下兼裕，至與耶律玦並稱忠直，不亦宜乎！
units.en: Liu Shen thrice held the Court of Justice and left the people free of wrongful oppression; once at the head of the Households Bureau he filled both imperial and local coffers; that he should stand with Yelu Jue among the loyal and upright—is that not exactly as it should be?
units.literal: Liu Shen thrice served at the Court of Justice, the people without wronged oppression; one ascent to the Households Bureau, upper and lower both ample; reaching being named together with Yelu Jue as loyal and upright—is it not fitting!
